# opnsense_ids_ruleset (Resource)

Enables one of the installable Suricata rulesets (**Services ▸ Intrusion Detection ▸ Administration ▸ Download**). Destroying the resource disables the ruleset. Rules are downloaded by the daily IDS update job or the **Download & Update Rules** button, then loaded when the IDS is reconfigured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_ids_ruleset" "sslbl" {
  filename = "emerging-scan.rules"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filename` (String) Ruleset file name, e.g. `emerging-scan.rules` or `abuse.ch.urlhaus.rules`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Ruleset description.
- `id` (String) Same as `filename`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the ruleset, for `opnsense_ids_policy.rulesets`.
